panels.description: Lifecycle health derived only from durable trading process state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE p.enabled
      AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping')
      AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at,p.started_at,p.created_at)>=now()-interval '2 minutes'
  ) AS "Active Processes",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE p.enabled
      AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping')
      AND p.stopped_at IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(p.heartbeat_at,p.updated_at,p.started_at,p.created_at)<now()-interval '2 minutes'
  ) AS "Stale Active Processes",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE p.status='failed' AND p.updated_at>=now()-interval '24 hours'
  ) AS "Failures 24h"
FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper';

panels.title: Realtime Process Health

panels.description: Real-time countdown for the canonical BTC five-minute market observed by every active trading process. Grafana Live updates this panel every second independently of the dashboard's global refresh timer. Waiting indicates no active process, market discovery, or disagreement between process feeds.
panels.title: 5-Minute Market Countdown

panels.description: Five-minute fresh-mark unrealized PnL from enabled, non-failed processes and their process-owned paper fills. Missing intervals mean no open position or no fresh mark.

targets.rawSql:
WITH processes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT process_id,name
  FROM polymarket.trading_processes
  WHERE process_scope='realtime_paper'
    AND enabled IS TRUE
    AND status IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'
), entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,p.name,o.order_id,o.token_id,
         MAX(f.timestamp_utc) AS filled_at,
         SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
         SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,
         SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees,
         m.official_resolution_received_at AS resolved_at
  FROM processes p
  JOIN polymarket.orders o USING(process_id)
  JOIN polymarket.fills f
    ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.process_id=o.process_id AND f.source='paper'
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=o.market_id
  WHERE f.timestamp_utc<=$__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND COALESCE(m.official_resolution_received_at,$__timeTo()::timestamptz)>=$__timeFrom()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY p.process_id,p.name,o.order_id,o.token_id,m.official_resolution_received_at
), marks AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes',c.source_timestamp)+interval '5 minutes' AS time,
         c.token_id,last(c.best_bid,c.source_timestamp) AS best_bid,
         MAX(c.source_timestamp) AS mark_at
  FROM polymarket.orderbook_checkpoints c
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT token_id FROM entries) t USING(token_id)
  WHERE c.integrity_status='ok' AND c.best_bid IS NOT NULL
    AND c.source_timestamp>=date_bin('5 minutes',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,timestamptz '1970-01-01')-interval '5 minutes'
    AND c.source_timestamp<=$__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY 1,c.token_id
)
SELECT m.time,e.name||' ['||left(e.process_id::text,8)||']' AS metric,
       SUM(e.filled_size*m.best_bid-e.entry_cost-e.entry_fees)::double precision AS value
FROM marks m
JOIN entries e
  ON e.token_id=m.token_id
 AND e.filled_at<=m.time
 AND m.mark_at>=e.filled_at
 AND (e.resolved_at IS NULL OR m.time<e.resolved_at)
WHERE m.time BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  AND m.mark_at BETWEEN m.time-interval '2 seconds' AND m.time
GROUP BY m.time,e.process_id,e.name
ORDER BY m.time,metric;

panels.title: Fresh Unrealized PnL by Process

panels.description: Process-lifetime realized PnL from enabled, non-failed processes, paper fills, and official outcomes, grouped by durable process ID.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS from_ts,$__timeTo()::timestamptz AS to_ts
), buckets AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_bin('5 minutes',from_ts,timestamptz '1970-01-01'),
    to_ts,interval '5 minutes'
  ) AS time FROM bounds
  UNION SELECT to_ts FROM bounds
), processes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.process_id,p.name,p.created_at
  FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  WHERE p.process_scope='realtime_paper'
    AND p.enabled IS TRUE
    AND p.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'
    AND (
      (p.enabled AND p.status IN ('starting','running','stopping') AND p.stopped_at IS NULL)
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM polymarket.fills f
        WHERE f.process_id=p.process_id AND f.source='paper'
      )
    )
), realized AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT f.process_id,m.official_resolution_received_at AS realized_at,
         (CASE WHEN o.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN f.size ELSE 0::numeric END
          -f.price*f.size-f.fee)::numeric AS net_pnl
  FROM polymarket.fills f
  JOIN polymarket.orders o
    ON o.order_id=f.order_id AND o.process_id=f.process_id
  JOIN processes p ON p.process_id=f.process_id
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=o.market_id
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE f.source='paper'
    AND m.official_outcome IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at<=b.to_ts
)
SELECT b.time,p.name||' ['||left(p.process_id::text,8)||']' AS metric,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.net_pnl) FILTER(WHERE r.realized_at<=b.time),0)::double precision AS value
FROM processes p
JOIN buckets b ON b.time>=p.created_at
LEFT JOIN realized r ON r.process_id=p.process_id AND r.realized_at<=b.time
GROUP BY b.time,p.process_id,p.name
ORDER BY b.time,metric;

panels.title: Cumulative Net Realized PnL by Process

targets.rawSql:
WITH processes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT process_id
  FROM polymarket.trading_processes
  WHERE process_scope = 'realtime_paper'
    AND enabled IS TRUE
    AND status IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'
), open_entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.process_id,
    o.order_id,
    o.token_id,
    SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
    SUM(f.price * f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,
    SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees
  FROM processes p
  JOIN polymarket.orders o USING (process_id)
  JOIN polymarket.fills f
    ON f.order_id = o.order_id
   AND f.process_id = o.process_id
   AND f.source = 'paper'
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id = o.market_id
  WHERE m.window_start <= now()
    AND m.window_end > now()
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY o.process_id, o.order_id, o.token_id
), marked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*, mark.best_bid
  FROM open_entries e
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.best_bid
    FROM polymarket.orderbook_checkpoints c
    WHERE c.token_id = e.token_id
      AND c.integrity_status = 'ok'
      AND c.best_bid IS NOT NULL
      AND c.source_timestamp BETWEEN now() - interval '2 seconds' AND now() + interval '1 second'
      AND c.received_at BETWEEN now() - interval '2 seconds' AND now()
    ORDER BY c.source_timestamp DESC, c.received_at DESC, c.ingest_sequence DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) mark ON true
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    SUM(filled_size * best_bid - entry_cost - entry_fees)
      FILTER (WHERE best_bid IS NOT NULL),
    0
  )::double precision AS "Fresh Unrealized PnL",
  COUNT(*) AS "Open Entry Orders"
FROM marked;

panels.title: Current Fresh Unrealized PnL
panels.description: Current-market unrealized PnL across enabled, non-failed realtime-paper processes and their open paper entries. PnL uses marks no older than two seconds; the entry count is not a dollar amount.

targets.rawSql:
WITH process_pnl AS (
  SELECT
    p.process_id,
    p.created_at,
    COALESCE(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN m.market_id IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
          ELSE
            CASE WHEN o.token_id = m.official_winning_token_id THEN f.size ELSE 0::numeric END
            - f.price * f.size
            - f.fee
        END
      ),
      0::numeric
    ) AS net_realized_pnl
  FROM polymarket.trading_processes p
  LEFT JOIN polymarket.fills f
    ON f.process_id = p.process_id
   AND f.source = 'paper'
  LEFT JOIN polymarket.orders o
    ON o.order_id = f.order_id
   AND o.process_id = f.process_id
  LEFT JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m
    ON m.market_id = o.market_id
   AND m.official_outcome IS NOT NULL
   AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
   AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE p.process_scope = 'realtime_paper'
    AND p.enabled IS TRUE
    AND p.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'
  GROUP BY p.process_id, p.created_at
)
SELECT net_realized_pnl::double precision AS "Best Active Process Lifetime Net Realized PnL"
FROM process_pnl
ORDER BY net_realized_pnl DESC, created_at DESC, process_id
LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Best Active Process Lifetime Net Realized PnL
panels.description: Highest lifetime net realized PnL from one enabled, non-failed realtime-paper process. Processes without resolved fills rank at zero; values use process-owned paper fills and official outcomes.

targets.rawSql:
WITH processes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT process_id,name,status,enabled,config,created_at,updated_at,heartbeat_at,stopped_at
  FROM polymarket.trading_processes
  WHERE process_scope='realtime_paper'
), filled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT o.process_id,o.order_id,o.token_id,o.market_id,
         MAX(f.timestamp_utc) AS filled_at,
         SUM(f.size)::numeric AS filled_size,
         SUM(f.price*f.size)::numeric AS entry_cost,
         SUM(f.fee)::numeric AS entry_fees
  FROM polymarket.orders o
  JOIN processes p USING(process_id)
  JOIN polymarket.fills f
    ON f.order_id=o.order_id AND f.process_id=o.process_id AND f.source='paper'
  GROUP BY o.process_id,o.order_id,o.token_id,o.market_id
), fill_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT process_id,COUNT(*) AS filled_orders,
         SUM(entry_cost)::numeric AS entry_notional,
         SUM(entry_fees)::numeric AS entry_fees,
         MAX(filled_at) AS last_fill_at
  FROM filled_orders GROUP BY process_id
), resolved_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT f.process_id,COUNT(*) AS resolved_positions,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN f.filled_size ELSE 0::numeric END
             -f.entry_cost)::numeric AS gross_realized_pnl,
         SUM(f.entry_fees)::numeric AS realized_fees,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN f.filled_size ELSE 0::numeric END
             -f.entry_cost-f.entry_fees)::numeric AS realized_pnl,
         MAX(m.official_resolution_received_at) AS last_resolution_at
  FROM filled_orders f
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m USING(market_id)
  WHERE m.official_outcome IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_winning_token_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.official_resolution_received_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY f.process_id
), open_entries AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT f.* FROM filled_orders f
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m USING(market_id)
  WHERE m.official_resolution_received_at IS NULL
), marked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*,mark.best_bid,mark.source_timestamp AS mark_at
  FROM open_entries e
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.best_bid,c.source_timestamp
    FROM polymarket.orderbook_checkpoints c
    WHERE c.token_id=e.token_id
      AND c.integrity_status='ok' AND c.best_bid IS NOT NULL
      AND c.source_timestamp BETWEEN now()-interval '2 seconds' AND now()+interval '1 second'
      AND c.received_at BETWEEN now()-interval '2 seconds' AND now()
    ORDER BY c.source_timestamp DESC,c.received_at DESC,c.ingest_sequence DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) mark ON true
), open_pnl AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT process_id,COUNT(*) AS open_positions,COUNT(best_bid) AS freshly_priced,
         COUNT(*)-COUNT(best_bid) AS stale_or_unpriced,
         COALESCE(SUM(filled_size*best_bid-entry_cost-entry_fees)
           FILTER(WHERE best_bid IS NOT NULL),0)::numeric AS unrealized_pnl,
         MAX(mark_at) AS latest_mark_at
  FROM marked GROUP BY process_id
), metrics AS (
  SELECT p.*,COALESCE(f.filled_orders,0) AS filled_orders,
         COALESCE(r.resolved_positions,0) AS resolved_positions,
         COALESCE(x.open_positions,0) AS open_positions,
         COALESCE(x.freshly_priced,0) AS freshly_priced,
         COALESCE(x.stale_or_unpriced,0) AS stale_or_unpriced,
         COALESCE(r.gross_realized_pnl,0)::numeric AS gross_realized_pnl,
         COALESCE(r.realized_fees,0)::numeric AS realized_fees,
         COALESCE(r.realized_pnl,0)::numeric AS realized_pnl,
         COALESCE(x.unrealized_pnl,0)::numeric AS unrealized_pnl,
         x.latest_mark_at,
         GREATEST(p.updated_at,COALESCE(f.last_fill_at,p.updated_at),
           COALESCE(r.last_resolution_at,p.updated_at),COALESCE(x.latest_mark_at,p.updated_at)) AS last_updated,
         CASE WHEN p.config#>>'{raw,btc_realtime_paper,paper,starting_collateral_usd}'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
              THEN (p.config#>>'{raw,btc_realtime_paper,paper,starting_collateral_usd}')::numeric END AS starting_collateral
  FROM processes p
  LEFT JOIN fill_stats f USING(process_id)
  LEFT JOIN resolved_stats r USING(process_id)
  LEFT JOIN open_pnl x USING(process_id)
)
SELECT name AS process_name,left(process_id::text,8) AS process_id,status,enabled,
       heartbeat_at AS last_heartbeat,
       EXTRACT(epoch FROM now()-COALESCE(heartbeat_at,updated_at))::bigint AS heartbeat_age_seconds,
       last_updated,filled_orders,resolved_positions,open_positions,freshly_priced,stale_or_unpriced,
       gross_realized_pnl::double precision,realized_fees::double precision,
       realized_pnl::double precision,unrealized_pnl::double precision,
       (realized_pnl+unrealized_pnl)::double precision AS total_pnl,
       CASE WHEN starting_collateral>0
            THEN ((realized_pnl+unrealized_pnl)/starting_collateral)::double precision END AS roi
FROM metrics
WHERE filled_orders>0 OR enabled OR status IN ('starting','running','stopping')
ORDER BY last_updated DESC,name;

panels.title: Process Lifetime PnL and Runtime Stats
panels.description: Durable process-level PnL and position counts derived from process-owned fills and official outcomes.

Point-in-time Binance and Chainlink prices seen by the selected trading process, expressed as basis-point movement from the current five-minute Chainlink opening price. Filled entries are marked by direction and official outcome. Gaps are intentional: they separate five-minute markets and exclude non-ready, missing, stale, or paused observations.

targets.rawSql:
WITH settings AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '2 hours' THEN interval '1 second'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '12 hours' THEN interval '3 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '2 days' THEN interval '10 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '7 days' THEN interval '30 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '30 days' THEN interval '2 minutes'
    ELSE interval '10 minutes'
  END AS bucket_width
), source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.snapshot_id,s.feature_as_of,s.window_start,s.market_id,
         s.chainlink_gap_bps::double precision AS chainlink_move_bps,
         (10000.0*(s.binance_price/s.chainlink_open_price-1))::double precision AS binance_move_bps
  FROM polymarket.btc_feature_snapshots s
  WHERE s.features->>'process_id'=${process_id:sqlstring}
    AND s.window_start BETWEEN date_bin('5 minutes',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,timestamptz '1970-01-01')-interval '5 minutes'
                           AND date_bin('5 minutes',$__timeTo()::timestamptz,timestamptz '1970-01-01')
    AND s.feature_as_of BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND s.readiness_status='ready'
    AND s.chainlink_price>0 AND s.chainlink_open_price>0 AND s.binance_price>0
), sampled AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT date_bin(cfg.bucket_width,s.feature_as_of,s.window_start) AS time,s.market_id,
         MIN(s.window_start) AS window_start,
         last(s.chainlink_move_bps,s.feature_as_of) AS chainlink_move_bps,
         last(s.binance_move_bps,s.feature_as_of) AS binance_move_bps
  FROM source s CROSS JOIN settings cfg
  GROUP BY 1,s.market_id
), markets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT market_id,window_start FROM source
), series AS (
  SELECT time,'Chainlink vs 5m open'::text AS metric,chainlink_move_bps AS value FROM sampled
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time,'Binance vs 5m open',binance_move_bps FROM sampled
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time,'Chainlink 5m open / resolution',0::double precision FROM sampled
  UNION ALL
  SELECT window_start-interval '1 millisecond','Chainlink vs 5m open',NULL::double precision FROM markets
  UNION ALL
  SELECT window_start-interval '1 millisecond','Binance vs 5m open',NULL::double precision FROM markets
), markers AS (
  SELECT s.feature_as_of AS time,
         CASE
           WHEN m.official_winning_token_id IS NULL THEN 'Entry OPEN '
           WHEN d.token_id=m.official_winning_token_id THEN 'Entry WIN '
           ELSE 'Entry LOSS '
         END||upper(d.outcome) AS metric,
         s.chainlink_move_bps AS value
  FROM source s
  JOIN polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d
    ON d.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id AND d.decision_at=s.feature_as_of
   AND d.process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid
   AND d.decision_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id=s.market_id
  WHERE d.action='buy' AND d.status='filled'
)
SELECT time,metric,value FROM series
UNION ALL
SELECT time,metric,value FROM markers
ORDER BY time,metric;

panels.title: Binance–Chainlink Movement and Filled Entries

panels.description: Normalized basis is the current Binance/Chainlink basis minus its recent neutral median. Positive convergence speed means the absolute lead is shrinking without crossing; negative values mean it is expanding. Calculations use only prior observations, are partitioned by five-minute market, and never bridge missing data or process pauses.

targets.rawSql:
WITH settings AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '2 hours' THEN interval '1 second'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '12 hours' THEN interval '3 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '2 days' THEN interval '10 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '7 days' THEN interval '30 seconds'
    WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz-$__timeFrom()::timestamptz<=interval '30 days' THEN interval '2 minutes'
    ELSE interval '10 minutes'
  END AS bucket_width
), source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.feature_as_of,s.window_start,s.market_id,s.basis_bps::double precision AS basis_bps
  FROM polymarket.btc_feature_snapshots s
  WHERE s.features->>'process_id'=${process_id:sqlstring}
    AND s.feature_as_of BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND s.readiness_status='ready'
    AND s.chainlink_price>0 AND s.chainlink_open_price>0 AND s.binance_price>0
), sampled AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT date_bin(cfg.bucket_width,s.feature_as_of,s.window_start) AS time,s.market_id,
         MIN(s.window_start) AS window_start,
         last(s.basis_bps,s.feature_as_of) AS basis_bps,
         MAX(cfg.bucket_width) AS bucket_width
  FROM source s CROSS JOIN settings cfg
  GROUP BY 1,s.market_id
), lagged AS (
  SELECT *,
         lag(time) OVER(PARTITION BY market_id ORDER BY time) AS previous_time,
         lag(basis_bps) OVER(PARTITION BY market_id ORDER BY time) AS previous_basis
  FROM sampled
), metrics AS (
  SELECT time,market_id,window_start,basis_bps,
         CASE
           WHEN previous_time IS NULL
             OR time-previous_time>bucket_width*2
             OR previous_basis IS NULL
             OR sign(previous_basis)=0
             OR sign(basis_bps)<>sign(previous_basis)
           THEN NULL
           ELSE (abs(previous_basis)-abs(basis_bps))
                /NULLIF(EXTRACT(epoch FROM time-previous_time),0)
         END AS convergence_speed
  FROM lagged
), markets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT market_id,window_start FROM source
), series AS (
  SELECT time,'Normalized Binance lead'::text AS metric,basis_bps AS value FROM metrics
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time,'Convergence speed',convergence_speed FROM metrics
  UNION ALL
  SELECT window_start-interval '1 millisecond','Normalized Binance lead',NULL::double precision FROM markets
  UNION ALL
  SELECT window_start-interval '1 millisecond','Convergence speed',NULL::double precision FROM markets
)
SELECT time,metric,value FROM series
ORDER BY time,CASE metric WHEN 'Normalized Binance lead' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;
